metric: Sum over each browser process tree of macOS physical footprint (proc_pid_rusage v2 ri_phys_footprint) and RSS, MiB. RSS double-counts shared pages. Medians per phase within a run; median/min/max across runs.

method.baseline: Installed Aside started with --headless, a throwaway profile, --force-device-scale-factor=2 and 1024x808 targets; no windows, Prohibited activation policy. It sends the windowed Chrome 154 user agent and navigator.webdriver is false; its User-Agent Client Hints brands are empty because of the override.
method.candidate: This repository's release bundle with ASIDE_BACKGROUND_WINDOW=1 and ASIDE_MOCK_KEYCHAIN=1, fresh data directory.
method.sequencing: Browsers run one at a time; real sites run the baseline first and the CEF run closes sites the baseline rejected; fixtures alternate the order per repetition.

phases.live: 8 samples every 3s from 75s after pages were ready
phases.idle: 8 samples every 3s from 215s after pages were ready

method.cef_policy: max 6 live content views (plus the shell), 30 s minimum idle, agent inspection protects 180 s
method.visibility_guard: window_audit.swift (50 ms polling, SIGKILL on frontmost, visible window, or Regular policy after 1 s) and watchdog.sh
caveats: Headless Aside renders its own browser UI (sidebar and toolbar) without any window; the CEF build includes its shell renderer. Neither is the same as a visible, interactive window.
Background CEF pages report visibilityState hidden; headless targets report visible.
The system was shared with other agents and builds; load is recorded per browser run.

Aside (headless).note: Complete; only the logged medians were kept because the harness was interrupted.

failure.error: The CEF browser process stopped responding about 44 s after launch while the real-site tabs were loading. A macOS sample showed the main (UI) thread, Chrome_IOThread, and several ThreadPoolForegroundWorker threads all waiting to acquire the same pthread reader-writer lock for writing inside the Chromium Embedded Framework; the last Chromium log line before it was a CEF "Timeout of new browser info response for frame" error. The API timed out and the harness was interrupted after 12 minutes; the instance was then stopped.
